headline: Outer banks blown out; stay inside for halibut and Cruz yellows
body:
A small craft advisory runs through Saturday afternoon in the outer waters, and the outer zones stay at 15–25 kn NW gusting 30 with 6–9 ft seas right through Sunday. Patchy morning fog both days. Inside the channel it's a different world: Santa Barbara Harbor sees 5 kn and about 3 ft, 70–72°F.

Skip the long runs. Santa Rosa Flats is 20–28 kn with 7 ft seas and 62°F water — under the break and unfishable. San Nicolas at 73 nm is 20+ kn and 5.6–6.1 ft; Osborn's 73.3°F is tempting but the calm there ends by midday Saturday and the trip home is upwind in advisory seas. Not worth it.

Fish the halibut sand instead: Goleta–Carpinteria in 40–120 ft, best Sunday with 2 kn at dawn and 3.7 ft. For yellowtail, run the backside of Santa Cruz Sunday — 71°F, under 4 ft, near-flat midday for 80-ft troll lines. Saturday's backside window closes early as west wind builds to 16 kn gusting 25.
